pages.text: $(thing)Starter Kit$() gives new players configurable starter gear on their first join. What you receive depends on the pack's settings. $(thing)Crafting Tweaks$() and $(thing)Searchables$() are small interface helpers.

pages.title: Crafting Tweaks
pages.text: Adds buttons beside crafting grids: rotate, clear, balance and spread items, and compress or decompress stacks. Each also has a key in Controls.

pages.title: Searchables
pages.text: A library that adds search bars with autocomplete to other mods' lists. You may only notice it as a search box inside another screen.
If you want to know what you start with, check your inventory on first join. Other tools: $(l:start_here/tools)Tools$(/l).$(br2)Related: $(l:home/inventory_tools)Inventory Tools$(/l).
